purpose: Founder-only affiliate application tracker. Application links are official program entry points; activation on CardNest remains separately gated.

programs.name: TCGplayer Affiliate Program
programs.officialTiming: No exact SLA published; TCGplayer says it will reach out shortly after the form is submitted.
programs.planningBuffer: Allow about 1–2 weeks for planning, but this is not a promised approval time.
programs.notes: Application submitted through Impact; CardNest website verified and connected. Awaiting TCGplayer review. Do not activate affiliate links until approval and exact network-generated links are available.

programs.name: eBay Partner Network
programs.officialTiming: No exact SLA published; eBay says it will email the outcome soon after application.
programs.planningBuffer: Allow about 1–2 weeks for planning, but this is not a promised approval time.
programs.notes: Strong complement to TCGplayer. Use clearly labeled outbound eBay links and EPN-approved promotional methods.

programs.name: Amazon Associates
programs.officialTiming: Amazon reviews after 3 qualifying sales; once that threshold is reached, it says review usually takes a day or two. The 3 sales must occur within 180 days.
programs.planningBuffer: Do not treat signup as final approval until Amazon completes the post-sale review.
programs.notes: Requires the exact Amazon Associate disclosure and tagged Special Links.

programs.notes: Family-friendly US-focused site is a good fit. Target documents a 7-day cookie after acceptance.
